dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.4:1 ratio of maximum visible base width to vertical height.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible left pectoral fin extending ventrally; distinct tri-color gradient pattern between the dorsal cape and the ventral surface.
